text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Wuppertal stood at 9.0 €/m², up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 27.2 % over the past five years, placing the city 33rd of the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² rent averages 540.0 €/month, while the asking premium over existing rents is 48.0 %.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.3 % and properties stay on the market for about 35 days; 17 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 12.8 %, reflecting moderate affordability pressure.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 9.47 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 9.22 €/m² and 9.67 €/m², implying a further 5.2 % rise.
